scope: Visitor-facing portfolio and photo browsing, with navigation checks of the resume, public demo and photo-session introduction. No publication or data-pipeline changes.
verified: Homepage View work reveals the embedded gallery through the existing cloud transition.
Direct /portfolio opens photographs, without the former YouTube introduction, snap scrolling or delayed white curtain.
Chinese and English gallery headers fit at 390x650; primary gallery controls are 44x44; document language follows the selected language.

Search is a focus-trapped dialog; / opens it; Escape closes it and restores focus without scrolling. A Paris query returned 3 collections and 26 photographs; entering a photograph and returning restored the query/results.
Both horizontal rows remain stationary while the search dialog is open.
Map tiles use correct absolute positioning; city selection supports native keyboard/touch input. Paris selection survived full reload after returning from its collection.
Photo Escape/back returns to the gallery or series context. Mobile landscape-series navigation restored the series section.
After opening work 96 at 1440x900 and returning at 390x650, the gallery starts at scrollY=975, is not inert, and work 96 is focused and visible at x=108.
About/CV is in the footer; its back link restores the portfolio route. Copy WeChat displays a success confirmation.
Photo-session introduction and public AI demo render without horizontal overflow at 390x650; the demo return link goes to the resume.
Custom not-found page renders with a return-to-photographs link; photo loading state was observed on a real collection navigation.
TypeScript noEmit incremental=false and git diff --check passed.

performance.method: Opt-in six-second rolling browser requestAnimationFrame cadence and completed WebGL draw submissions. This is not a GPU timer or physical-display counter.

limits: Warm local Next.js development preview on this Mac, not a production or cold-network benchmark.
Phone layouts use a resized browser viewport; physical-phone performance was not measured.
The photo error retry boundary is implemented and type-checked; no backend outage was forced.
